title: Mostar Guide
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm install --package-lock-only && npm run check && npm run build'

asset_issues.issue: Specified remote font returns HTTP 200 without Access-Control-Allow-Origin; Chromium rejected cross-origin font loading. Query-string retry did not resolve CORS.
asset_issues.resolution: Recovered exact 68832-byte original to assets/OggText-Medium.woff2 under TASK.md recovery allowance; packaged in dist/assets; verified browser font loading.

notes: Ready for management review; not deployed or pushed.
Standalone vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. Build only copies static deliverables into dist/. Dependency lock saved; no node_modules.
Seven scene layers and three pin icons use exact remote URLs and all returned 200 in both viewport checks.
Language and notes buttons have exact specified markup; no additional behavior or content was specified.
Validation limited to available Chromium and required viewport sizes; remote images require network access.
Only this project and its own supplied visual reference were read; no agents or additional sessions created.
